minutes.headline: Commission required a full notice of intent for a Fire Road addition and issued an enforcement order for pond-side clearing.
minutes.summary: The Commission heard a state presentation on emerald ash borer, then worked through several wetlands hearings. It gave a negative determination at Flat Hill Road, a positive determination at 46 Fire Road, an enforcement order for unpermitted clearing at a pond lot, and approved a Prospect Street house with work limited to the 50-foot zone. Several hearings were continued to May 2nd, and a Saturday regulation review meeting was set for June 16th.

what_happened.line: The Commission issued a positive determination for the 46 Fire Road addition, which requires a full notice of intent to go forward.
An enforcement order was voted for unpermitted clearing at a pond lot; the owner is to cover bare soil with hay within seven days.
Applicants at 307 Townsend Harbor Road were told fines will be issued if no viable application is presented; the hearing was continued to May 2nd.
The Commission approved 63 Prospect Street with the limit of work set at the 50-foot no structure zone, and approved the notice of intent at 654 Mass Ave.
A Saturday regulation review meeting was set for June 16th, 8 to noon.

why_it_matters: Wetlands rulings decide what neighbors and owners may build or clear near ponds and buffer zones, and unpermitted work can bring fines and orders to restore the ground.
The June regulation review could change the local wetlands rules that apply to future projects in town.
watch_next: May 2nd: continued hearings resume, including 307 Townsend Harbor Road, Hickory Hills and 54 Maple Parkway.
June 16th, 8 to noon: Saturday regulation review meeting.
